title: Supply Chain Attack on tiny-server
technical_mechanism: -- # `tiny-server` was removed from crates.io for malicious code This crate was part of a typosquatting malware cluster published by the malicious user `http-tiny` and contained a malware payload in `build.rs` to exfiltrate host information to the attacker. This advisory is to retrospectively document
